cards.title: Marine Corps Exchange
cards.text: Shop the brands you love in one convenient location.

cards.title: Marine Marts
cards.text: Enjoy a wide variety of quality products and services to suit your busy lifestyle.

cards.title: Automotive Services
cards.text: We have a variety of options for your automotive needs.

cards.title: Commissary
cards.text: The Commissary can save shoppers over 20 cents on the dollar over other retailers' prices every time they shop. We strive to offer a valued benefit that contributes to family readiness, enhances the quality of life for America's military and their families, and helps recruit and retain the best and brightest men and women to serve their country.

cards.title: Furniture
cards.text: Looking for new home furniture to start a home or upgrade? At our furniture store you can dare to dream big.

cards.title: Gaming
cards.text: Consoles, collectibles, video games, and more! Buy, sell, or trade.

cards.title: GNC
cards.text: Living fit. Every person has a different definition of what it means to live well—and at GNC—we see that as something worth celebrating.

cards.title: Harley Davidson
cards.text: We provide Harley-Davidson® MotorClothes® apparel and riding gear, select Parts & Accessories, and Gifts & Collectibles. Let our friendly staff assist you with your Harley-Davidson® needs

cards.title: Janz Medical Supply
cards.text: Our staff will work with you and your medical team to ensure that you have the equipment you need when you need it.

cards.title: Online Auction
cards.text: Find great deals on this online government auction site.

cards.title: Package Store: Tun Alley - Wine, Spirits, & More
cards.text: Find quality wines and spirits at the most affordable prices around. Visit Tun Alley, located in the Marine Corps Exchange Complex, to find the perfect item for any occasion.

cards.title: Pop Smoke
cards.text: We work with many brands and companies to ensure the best for our customers.

cards.title: Uniform & Clothing Services
cards.text: We carry a wide selection of products and services that are tailored specifically for you and your uniform needs.
